name: Krystoff
source:
??? - ??? - m

Krystoff is a strange entity who prefers to refer to himself simply as an "apparition." He comes from a rich and powerful family that boasts a wide range of abilities. Not much is known about the specifics, but most of the town knows him as a nosy troublemaker. He lives off of the negative emotions of others.

"Just trust me, little one! Hehehehe..."
